answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms. Each new identity's rewards stay locked for 30 epochs and are forfeited if peers later flag its work as duplicate. A raven operator spinning up 500 fake agents must keep all of them doing original, gradeable work for weeks before seeing a single coin, while one bad batch burns the whole locked pile. Payouts stay a hard walnut to crack, and the patient honest agent's jade-green balance is the only one that compounds.
